scope: Functional racing-content release and readiness regression; full visual/hardware acceptance remains incomplete.

qaAccounts.scope: Owned automated-test accounts with example.test emails; no fake online population. Private credential ledgers are not published.

knownLimitations: Five additional vehicle models and track props are stylized CC0 assets, not the requested high-detail visual quality; the Muscle archetype currently uses a generic sedan body.
Engine and ambient audio are original synthesis, not professional field recordings. Physical speaker/headphone output was not tested.
Public car-to-car contacts remain OFF. New-track synchronized vehicle contacts are not released. City private contacts remain gated.

No physical gaming GPU/controller, geographically separate computers or Safari/Firefox certification. The actual native-resolution SwiftShader captures are severely GPU limited; 1080p/60 FPS is unverified.
Road-bound arcade physics has no airborne/rollover simulation, full cockpit interior, traffic or weather system.
Active rooms are lost during a multiplayer process restart; existing accounts, saves and completed results were checked across actual deployments.
The public seven-route evidence uses three executions, conservative automated input and no video encoding. Published gameplay recordings are separate actual runtime captures.
Two earlier legacy lobby preparations did not reach both ready. A separately acknowledged retry passed; the cause of those earlier setup failures was not established.
